title: Best-of-5 Championship Series & Streak Multiplier system tracking Tactical Forks, Center-Nexus Control, and Flawless Series Sweeps inside the top status ribbon.
author_role: Principal Systems & Economy Architect (Data schemas, progression curves, state ledgers)
summary: Track match progression across a Best-of-5 championship series with tactical point multipliers for center-nexus holds, fork creations, and flawless sweeps.
technical_specification: Maintain `state.stats.series = { playerWins: 0, aiWins: 0, ties: 0, targetWins: 3, roundIndex: 1 }`. On round end, increment winner score. Detect 'Center-Nexus Control' if sector 4 belongs to winner (`+250` pts). Evaluate 'Tactical Fork' when a move creates >=2 simultaneous win-threat vectors (`+500` pts, increment `state.stats.forksCreated`). Series multiplier `state.stats.multiplier` starts at 1.0, climbing `+0.5` per consecutive player win up to 3.0x. Award 'Flawless Sweep' (`+2500` pts) if player reaches 3 series wins with 0 losses. Render series pips and active multiplier in the top ribbon.
acceptance_criteria: First contender to reach 3 round wins completes the championship series and displays sweep bonus if opponent wins equal 0.
Placing the nexus or establishing two simultaneous winning threats updates score bonuses and active streak multipliers immediately.
